locations.title: Areas
locations.description: One per line. Empty line or no lines = national average. A province name (e.g. DKI Jakarta, Jawa Barat) or "Province / City" (e.g. Jawa Barat / Kota Bandung). Province ids from the site also work.

priceTypes.title: Market types
priceTypes.description: 1 = traditional market, 2 = modern market, 3 = wholesale (pedagang besar), 4 = producer.

startDate.title: From
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = 7 days before the end date.

endDate.title: To
endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = today (the latest day is usually published a day late).

reportType.title: Period
reportType.description: Daily prices, or the site's weekly / monthly averages.

commodities.title: Only these commodities
commodities.description: Optional. Keep rows whose commodity or group contains one of these words, e.g. beras, cabai, bawang. Empty = all.

includeGroupAverages.title: Include group averages
includeGroupAverages.description: Also keep the group rows (e.g. "Beras" = average of all rice qualities), marked rataRataKelompok: true.

maxItems.title: Max price records
maxItems.description: Stop after this many rows. One area for 7 days is roughly 30 commodities × 7 = 210 rows.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually not needed. If runs get blocked, use Apify residential proxy in Indonesia (ID).
